# teams_messaging_configuration (Resource)

Manages the MessagingConfiguration configuration via Set-CsTeamsMessagingConfiguration.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Identity of the existing object whose configuration is managed.

### Optional

- `communities` (String) Maps to the -Communities parameter.
- `content_based_phishing_check` (String) Maps to the -ContentBasedPhishingCheck parameter.
- `custom_emojis` (Boolean) Maps to the -CustomEmojis parameter.
- `enable_in_organization_chat_control` (Boolean) Maps to the -EnableInOrganizationChatControl parameter.
- `enable_video_message_captions` (Boolean) Maps to the -EnableVideoMessageCaptions parameter.
- `file_type_check` (String) Maps to the -FileTypeCheck parameter.
- `messaging_notes` (String) Maps to the -MessagingNotes parameter.
- `report_incorrect_security_detections` (String) Maps to the -ReportIncorrectSecurityDetections parameter.
- `storyline` (String) Maps to the -Storyline parameter.
- `url_reputation_check` (String) Maps to the -UrlReputationCheck parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
